summary: Seeds the existing per-year rate table community_assessment_rate_history (migration 465) for the community configured for builder transfers: 2025 and 2026 at $495.00 with their evidence, so a builder ownership period spanning calendar years uses each year's rate. No new table. No ledger, GL, tenure, ownership or sale row changes.

preflight.name: community_assessment_rate_history exists (465)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'community_assessment_rate_history'

preflight.name: no 2025/2026 homeowner rate on file yet for the configured community
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_assessment_rate_history WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006' AND owner_class = 'homeowner' AND fiscal_year IN (2025, 2026)

expected_changes: Inserts 2 rows into community_assessment_rate_history for the configured community (2025 and 2026, homeowner, 49500 cents).
No schema change; no existing row is changed.

verify.name: two seeded years at $495.00
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_assessment_rate_history WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006' AND owner_class = 'homeowner' AND annual_amount_cents = 49500 AND fiscal_year IN (2025, 2026)
